changes_made.explanation: Normalized dataset names to consistent title case formatting and simplified the output description
Consolidated case variations of 'exact-match' to standard 'Exact Match' form
No LLM-as-judge evaluation method is used in this paper - the LLMs are used as generation models, not evaluators
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper - evaluation is done purely through automatic exact-match metrics

overall_notes: The paper focuses on addressing the 'reversal curse' phenomenon in LLMs through a novel data strategy (PORE). It evaluates performance using automatic exact-match scoring on question-answering tasks. The extraction was generally accurate, with minor normalization needed for consistent naming conventions.
